list.name: ds_cm
list.label: SCCM Database
list.description: Microsoft SQL Server data source for the Configuration Manager site database (CM_<site code>), with a read-only login. Chosen automatically if its name contains "SCCM", "ConfigMgr" or "Configuration Manager"; otherwise pick it here.

list.definition:
SELECT Name AS __text, CollectionID AS __value
FROM dbo.v_Collection
WHERE CollectionType = 2
ORDER BY Name
list.label: Collection
list.name: cmcoll
list.query:
SELECT Name AS __text, CollectionID AS __value
FROM dbo.v_Collection
WHERE CollectionType = 2
ORDER BY Name

title: SCCM - Overview

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT s.Client0, cs.ClientActiveStatus, cs.LastEvaluationHealthy
  FROM dbo.v_ClientCollectionMembers m
  JOIN dbo.v_R_System s ON s.ResourceID = m.ResourceID
  LEFT JOIN dbo.v_CH_ClientSummary cs ON cs.ResourceID = m.ResourceID
  WHERE m.CollectionID = '${cmcoll}'
), comp AS (
  SELECT Status FROM dbo.v_ComponentSummarizer WHERE TallyInterval = '0001128000100008'
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS [Devices],
  SUM(CASE WHEN Client0 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Clients],
  SUM(CASE WHEN Client0 = 1 AND ClientActiveStatus = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Active clients],
  SUM(CASE WHEN Client0 = 1 AND ISNULL(ClientActiveStatus, 0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Inactive clients],
  SUM(CASE WHEN Client0 = 1 AND LastEvaluationHealthy = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Clients failing health checks],
  SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(Client0, 0) <> 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Devices without a client],
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.v_SiteSystemSummarizer WHERE Status > 0) AS [Site systems not healthy],
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comp WHERE Status > 0) AS [Components not healthy]
FROM c

panels.title: Components not healthy

panels.description: The site (or the sites of the hierarchy) this database belongs to.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  SiteCode AS [Site code],
  SiteName AS [Site name],
  CASE Type WHEN 1 THEN 'Secondary' WHEN 2 THEN 'Primary' WHEN 4 THEN 'Central administration' ELSE 'Other' END AS [Type],
  Version AS [Version],
  BuildNumber AS [Build],
  LOWER(ServerName) AS [Site server],
  CASE Status WHEN 1 THEN 1 WHEN 2 THEN 2 WHEN 3 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END AS [Status]
FROM dbo.v_Site
ORDER BY SiteCode

panels.title: Site

panels.description: Every site system role with its status. Free space is shown for roles that report a disk.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('Display=\\', s.SiteSystem) > 0 AND CHARINDEX('\"]', s.SiteSystem) > 0
       THEN LOWER(SUBSTRING(s.SiteSystem, CHARINDEX('Display=\\', s.SiteSystem) + 10, CHARINDEX('\"]', s.SiteSystem) - CHARINDEX('Display=\\', s.SiteSystem) - 10))
       ELSE s.SiteSystem END AS [Server],
  REPLACE(s.Role, 'SMS ', '') AS [Role],
  CASE s.Status WHEN 0 THEN 1 WHEN 1 THEN 2 WHEN 2 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END AS [Status],
  CASE WHEN s.BytesTotal > 0 THEN CAST(s.PercentFree AS int) END AS [Free %],
  CASE WHEN s.BytesTotal > 0 THEN CAST(s.BytesFree / 1048576.0 AS decimal(10, 1)) END AS [Free GB],
  s.DownSince AS [Down since],
  s.TimeReported AS [Last reported]
FROM dbo.v_SiteSystemSummarizer s
ORDER BY s.Status DESC, 1, 2

panels.title: Site system roles

panels.description: Clients in the selected collection by client version. Several versions mean some clients still need upgrading.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  ISNULL(NULLIF(s.Client_Version0, ''), 'No client') AS [Client version],
  COUNT(*) AS [Devices]
FROM dbo.v_ClientCollectionMembers m
JOIN dbo.v_R_System s ON s.ResourceID = m.ResourceID
WHERE m.CollectionID = '${cmcoll}'
GROUP BY ISNULL(NULLIF(s.Client_Version0, ''), 'No client')
ORDER BY 1 DESC

panels.title: Clients by client version

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(REPLACE(o.Caption0, 'Microsoft ', ''), REPLACE(ISNULL(s.Operating_System_Name_and0, 'Unknown'), 'Microsoft Windows NT ', '')) AS [Operating system],
  COUNT(*) AS [Devices],
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.Client0 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [With client]
FROM dbo.v_ClientCollectionMembers m
JOIN dbo.v_R_System s ON s.ResourceID = m.ResourceID
LEFT JOIN dbo.v_GS_OPERATING_SYSTEM o ON o.ResourceID = m.ResourceID
WHERE m.CollectionID = '${cmcoll}'
GROUP BY COALESCE(REPLACE(o.Caption0, 'Microsoft ', ''), REPLACE(ISNULL(s.Operating_System_Name_and0, 'Unknown'), 'Microsoft Windows NT ', ''))
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

description: Configuration Manager at a glance: clients, site systems, components and the operating systems in a collection. Reads the site database.
